name: Adah
description: Woman living at the time before the Flood

points: Lamech took unto him two wives: this is the first time you read about multiple wives, in Genesis 4:19. Adah bare Jabal, the father of such as dwell in tents and have cattle: dealing with pricing and unrighteousness. His brother Jubal was the father of all such as handle the harp and organ: do you think it was holy music? It was songs about murder, drugs, debauchery, and adultery. That is what was going on in this city. Zillah bare Tubalcain, an instructer of every artificer in brass and iron: weapons. This man was making all kinds of weapons.
